name: Master Components Ltd.
summary: Master Components Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of plastic engineering components and sub-assemblies. The company offers precision molding services, including thermoplastic, thermoset injection, transfer, and compression molding, alongside assembly and build-to-print services. They provide end-to-end solutions from design to assembly, leveraging vertically integrated operations that encompass in-house mold design, manufacturing, and component molding. Master Components Ltd. serves a diverse range of industrial sectors, including electrical, automotive, industrial, healthcare, childcare, and medical equipment, providing critical components such as switch parts, enclosures, and high-precision plastic parts.
